# Mobile Care USA

> Mobile Care USA is a walk-in phone repair and mobile retail company with 8 mall-based stores across Georgia, Virginia, North Carolina, and Michigan. Certified technicians handle smartphone, tablet, and laptop repairs, most done the same day, with a 30-day parts and labor warranty. The stores also sell certified pre-owned iPhones and Samsung Galaxy phones and a range of phone accessories. Customers rate Mobile Care 4.9 on Google, and the technicians have repaired more than 1 million devices.

Key facts:
- No appointment needed. Customers walk in and get a free diagnostic and a clear quote before any work starts.
- Most repairs are finished the same day, often while the customer waits.
- Repairs use quality-tested parts and come with a 30-day parts and labor warranty.
- Pre-owned phones are fully unlocked, inspected, and warranty-backed.
- A trade-in program lets customers put their current device toward an upgrade.

## Repair Services

- Screen Replacement: Cracked or unresponsive displays are replaced, then color and touch are calibrated.
- Back Glass Repair: Shattered rear glass is replaced with a color-matched panel, and wireless charging is verified afterward.
- Charging Port Replacement: Charging ports are cleaned, repaired, or replaced, and charging and data transfer are tested.
- Battery Replacement: Worn batteries are replaced with high-capacity cells, then calibrated so battery health reads accurately.
- Camera Replacement: Front and rear camera modules and lenses are repaired or replaced.
- Water Damage Repair: Liquid-damaged devices are cleaned, dried, and diagnosed to recover function and data.

Supported brands include Apple iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, and other Android phones, plus iPads, tablets, and laptops such as MacBooks.

## Certified Pre-Owned Phones

- [Apple iPhone](https://mobilecareusa.com/pre-owned/apple): iPhone 11 through iPhone 18 series.
- [Samsung Galaxy](https://mobilecareusa.com/pre-owned/samsung): Galaxy Z (Fold and Flip) series and Galaxy S21 through S26 series.
